Main Channel depth after the project, MLLW

fonte: Port of Los Angeles; U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
legenda: Main Channel: from 45 ft to 53 ft below mean lower low water.
credito_tela: Source: Port of Los Angeles; U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, 2013
nota: O 53 é o trecho chamado Main Channel; a aproximação e a entrada têm 78 pés (USACE NCF), o número que o BTS publica como 'main channel' (evt.num-14). A página do porto, relida hoje, diz '-53' Main Channel water depth'.
narracao: The harbor at the end of it was deepened by dredges. By 2013, the port and the Corps of Engineers had taken its Main Channel from forty-five feet to fifty-three.

na_tela.texto: Port of Los Angeles and U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
Source: Port of Los Angeles; U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, 2013

needs_dados: Main Channel de 45 para 53 pés (MLLW) até 21/02/2013, porto e USACE (evt.afi-42, doc-21) → 45 FT → 53 FT (2013)

conferencia.prova: 'WHEREAS, the Main Channel Deepening project now provides -53 ft. depths in the main channel and turning basins at the Port' (21/02/2013); o relatório do Chief of Engineers: 'the existing -45-foot-deep main channel … to a depth of -53 feet MLLW'
conferencia.voz: By 2013, the port and the Corps of Engineers had taken its Main Channel from forty-five feet to fifty-three
